prompt_positive:
You are an information extraction system. Summarize the following dialogue and extract the key information into the following structured format:

User Profile: <brief description of the user>
Problem: <main issue described>
Resolution: <Concise bullet points of key actions, final decision and outcomes only. Merge the related points and outcome. Max 5 bullets.>

Dialogue:
prompt_negative:
You are a summarization system. Summarize only the unimportant information, irrelevant details, pleasantries, and chit-chat from the following dialogue. Strictly ignore the main problem, troubleshooting steps, and final resolution. Extract the information into the following structured format:

User Profile: <brief description of the user based only on chit-chat and pleasantries>
Problem: <off-topic remarks or filler conversation, not the actual issue>
Resolution: <Concise bullet points of unrelated remarks, tangents, and closing pleasantries only. Merge related points. Max 5 bullets.>

Dialogue:
